svg.aria-label: Geminga mark: an open outer ring around a closed inner ring and an off-centre point
svg.title: Geminga
svg.desc:
Geminga is a gamma-ray source with no counterpart at any other wavelength. The name is Milanese for "it is not there". The mark says that with an absence: the outer ring is open, and the opening is the subject. The inner ring is closed, so the gap reads as a decision rather than a broken circle.
Three elements, not four. An earlier draft had four bands at descending opacity, which at 16px collapsed into a smudge and at any size read as texture instead of intent. A mark that needs its own faint detail to look considered is not yet finished.
The point sits off axis, on the same diagonal as the opening. A mark that resolves to a perfect bullseye reads as a target; this one reads as something observed and not fully accounted for, which is the posture the system takes toward anything it is told.
